name: smwmusic-kirby-super-star-hail-to-the-king-king-dedede-remix
title: Kirby Super Star - Hail to the King! ~ King Dedede (Remix)
description:
𝐃𝐎𝐍'𝐓 𝐁𝐄 𝐒𝐎 𝐇𝐀𝐑𝐃-𝐁𝐎𝐈𝐋𝐄𝐃 𝐄𝐆𝐆𝐌𝐀𝐍

Did an arrangement of King Dedede's Theme from the entire Kirby Series. As a massive simp for King Dedede and his theme songs, I felt the need to arrange his most iconic track. It's easily one of my favorite songs in the series, including just about every version it available.

Really wanted to base this off both the Dreamland 1 and Super Star version and fuse both of them together into this one big track.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D# Minor (Remix Pitch) [turned on by default]
2. C Minor (Super Star Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Default Echo Buffer, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
2. Lowers Echo Buffer [turned on by default]
